title: Grateful Dead Live at Tivolis Koncertsal on 1972-04-14
source: Bertha Remaster of the Multi Track Master Reel source (SHN ID 34552)

ai_review.summary: Remastered soundboard capture of the legendary 4‑14‑72 show – a smoking Dark Star, pedal‑steel Looks Like Rain and stellar keyboards make it an all‑time classic.
ai_review.review: The 1972‑04‑14 performance is hailed as a gold‑standard concert with high‑energy jams, standout Dark Star, Playin' in the Band and a magical pedal‑steel moment on Looks Like Rain. Jay Ashley’s remaster delivers crisp soundboard clarity, though a few tracks sit a bit lower in level. Overall the musical fire and superb musicianship outweigh any minor volume quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the show’s exceptional performance and the high‑quality soundboard remaster; only one 4‑star note mentions minor level issues, keeping the overall rating very strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered by Jay Ashley – crisp mix, great instrument separation and overall clarity. A handful of songs (e.g., “Playin' in the Band”, “El Paso”) sit slightly lower in volume, but they do not detract from the listening experience.

standout_songs: Looks Like Rain (Jerry on pedal steel)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert rolls from an intense opening through a soaring Dark Star, then maintains high momentum with tight jams and seamless transitions; many reviewers call it brilliant from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Pedal‑steel on “Looks Like Rain” is described as a phantom train; his guitar tone and vocal delivery are repeatedly praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work is noted for its solid foundation within the tight ensemble, especially in the harmonized sections.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocals stay on point with no lyric flubs; his verses line up cleanly throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s keyboards receive glowing remarks – “All i can say is WOW Keith” and “especially the keyboards”.
